name: @ktjn/searchable-fixtures
description: Phase 0 reference fixture corpus (docs/project/roadmap.md, docs/guides/indexing.md): a deterministic, realistically-shaped CMS-export-style HTML corpus generator, so correctness tests exercise the real indexer/client against content shaped like the target deployment instead of only tiny inline fixtures.
